# Paperform

Paperform is a flexible online form builder that combines beautiful design with serious digital smarts

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/paperform/.

## Actions

- **Get Space** (read-only): Retrieve a space by ID from Paperform.
- **List Forms** (read-only): List all forms accessible by the authorized user.
- **List Spaces** (read-only): List all spaces accessible by the authorized user.
- **Get Space Forms** (read-only): Retrieve forms in a space from Paperform.
- **List Translations** (read-only): List all translations accessible by the authorized user.
